'''Julio Beni''' was an underboss in the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] who escaped [[Prison/Legends|prison]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and hired underworld figures to transport thems back to [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] before the authorities could catch Beni.<ref name="Mission" />
